title: S09T02 - Rehearse clean installs, upgrades, downgrades, migrations, and rollback
description: Run the full release matrix on supported operating systems and storage/schema histories, including broken, interrupted, and version-skew fixtures.
acceptanceCriteria: Every supported install and upgrade path passes the golden loop, strict doctor, adapter checks, extension checks, and uninstall or rollback verification.
Unsupported downgrade or skew paths fail closed without damaging canonical records and name the supported recovery.
All repository changes are captured in one or more scoped Git checkpoint commits, or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health checks pass before closeout.
